india_trends.title: 240% rally in six months! Defence stock Raymond hits 52-week high; exit or hold? Explained with target, stop-loss, ratio

india_trends.title: NSE shares dip below listing price — will it rebound or more pain ahead? | Explained with support, resistance, target

india_trends.title: 30% rally this month! PC Jeweller share price near its 52-week high; can the stock rally further?
india_trends.summary: On a monthly scale, PC Jeweller share price is up about 30% so far in September, looking set to extend gains for the third consecutive month. Year-to-date, the jewellery stock is up over 50%, while in the last six months, it has surged nearly 75%.&nbsp;

india_trends.title: Stock market holidays: Taiwan to Shanghai Stock Exchange — These Asian markets to remain closed today
india_trends.summary: Markets in China, Taiwan, and South Korea are closed for holidays on Friday, September 25. China observes the Mid-Autumn Festival, while Taiwan and South Korea celebrate their respective festivals, with all markets set to reopen next week.

india_trends.title: Hero Motors shares up 20% — what's driving the stock? Explained with target, stop-loss
india_trends.summary: Hero Motors shares surged 20% on September 25, recovering from a weak debut. The stock climbed from an IPO price of ₹84 to ₹141.85, marking a total gain of nearly 69%. Analysts suggest investors wait for stabilization due to premium valuation concerns.

india_trends.title: PB Fintech shares slump 40% in two sessions| What Jefferies, Morgan Stanley, BofA say on the stock
india_trends.summary: PB Fintech shares rose nearly 4% after a 36% plunge, yet fell over 6% today, losing about 40% in two sessions due to proposed regulatory changes. Analysts are cautious, advising against immediate investments amid weakening technical indicators and revised price targets from global brokerages.

india_trends.title: Welspun Corp share price hits 52-week high after subsidiary wins its largest-ever order | All details here
india_trends.summary: Welspun Corp share price climbed over 5% in early deals on the BSE on Friday, 25 September, to hit its 52-week high of ₹2,837.50, boosted by the company's announcement about its subsidiary winning its largest-ever order in the US.

india_trends.title: Bonus issue record date today: Last chance to buy Aastha Spintex shares as deadline approaches-Check stock performance
india_trends.summary: Aastha Spintex Limited's shares are under focus ahead of its 1:1 bonus issue record date on September 28. Investors must buy before September 25 to be eligible for the bonus. The company has also secured a ₹25 crore order for Greige Fabric from JSK Textile LLP.

india_trends.title: ₹9,450 turns into over ₹1.30 lakh in one day despite 35% fall in PB Fintech share price; here's how
india_trends.summary: PB Fintech shares fell 35% on September 24, leading to a market cap loss of ₹30,000 crore. This triggered a surge in put options, allowing traders to profit significantly from the decline. The stock reached a 52-week low due to regulatory changes proposed by the IRDAI.
